Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Analista Desenvolvedor Java, atuará no ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de aplicações modernas baseadas em Java, com foco em arquiteturas escaláveis, microsserviços e integrações corporativas.

Sua atuação será predominantemente back-end, envolvendo regras de negócio, integrações via APIs RESTful e persistência de dados em ambientes cloud.

Eventualmente, poderá também contribuir no front-end, com frameworks JavaScript modernos (React, Angular ou similares), sendo capacitado no landscape adotado pela empresa.

Participará ativamente de todo o ciclo de vida dos produtos — desde o design técnico e implementação até automação de deploy, testes e observabilidade — em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e orientado à entrega contínua de valor.

⚙ Requisitos e qualificações

-Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios

-Java (mínimo 5 anos de experiência, incluindo Java 17/21), com domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem (records, streams, sealed classes, etc.).

-Spring Boot / Quarkus / Micronaut: desenvolvimento de microsserviços, APIs e integrações assíncronas (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

-APIs RESTful / GraphQL: criação e consumo de serviços em aplicações corporativas.

-Banco de dados relacionais e NoSQL: experiência com PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB ou DynamoDB.

-Containers e Cloud: conhecimento em Docker e implantação em plataformas Kubernetes (EKS, AKS ou GKE).

-CI/CD: pipelines automatizados com GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins ou ArgoCD.

-Front-end básico: sólidos conhecimentos em HTML5, CSS3 e JavaScript, com experiência em React, Angular ou Vue.js.

Desejáveis

Experiência prévia com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) ou outros CMS corporativos, preferencialmente em contexto Headless.

Conhecimento em Java Content Repository (JCR) e manipulação de conteúdo em AEM.

Vivência em Apache Sling e entendimento do modelo de recursos e resoluções de request.

DevOps e Infraestrutura como Código: uso de Terraform, AWS CDK e Helm para provisionamento automatizado.

Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) e práticas de logging estruturado e tracing distribuído.

Experiência com Apache Kafka, ElasticSearch e Redis para aplicações de alta disponibilidade e performance.

Diferenciais

Experiência prática com AEM as a Cloud Service, incluindo uso do SDK local e pipelines automatizados.

Conhecimento em Headless AEM, integração com frameworks SPA (React, Next.js , Angular).

Aplicação de boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT, OWASP Top 10, LGPD).

Familiaridade com CI/CD pipelines cloud-native, deploy automatizado e ambientes distribuídos.

Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou migração de aplicações legadas para cloud/microsserviços.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage approximately 40 applications , maintaining stability and version consistency.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps templates for CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain automated smoke tests for proactive issue detection.

Required Qualifications:

  • Expert-level experience with Java 8 and Spring Frameworks (Spring 4.1.3, Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Proven expertise working with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, validation, and performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of Tomcat server configuration and deployments.
  • Experience developing scalable applications with Spring Boot 1.5.x .
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and automated testing frameworks .
  • Solid knowledge of UI frameworks (JSP, jQuery, AngularJS).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging, log validation, and application migration.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
Lead Web Designer Job Description

Location: Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required

Type: Freelance

About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.

The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Web Designer to own management and execution of web projects for our SaaS and B2B clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency.

The Lead Web Designer is both hands-on and strategic: you’ll design systems, shape web content strategies, and present creative directions to clients with clarity and confidence. You’ll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the creative process from strategy through design execution, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality.
  • Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites.
  • Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability.
  • Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution.
  • Present and pitch creative work directly to clients, explaining decisions with clarity and confidence.
  • Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life.
  • Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality.
  • Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end web projects: strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution.
  • Proven ability to lead client conversations and present creative directions with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences.
  • Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles.
  • Proficiency in modern design tools (Figma required; Adobe Creative Suite a plus).
  • Webflow knowledge required; familiarity with responsive best practices and handoff to development.
  • Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred.
  • Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.

Why Join BX Studio?

  • Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands.
  • Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities.
  • Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design.
  • Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Analista Pl - Qualidade (Auditoria) - Pesquisa Nacional - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Requisitos

A área de Qualidade em Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por assegurar que todos os processos relacionados a ensaios clínicos sejam conduzidos em conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais, garantindo a integridade científica dos dados, a segurança dos participantes e a aderência regulatória. Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.

  • Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;

  • Vivência prévia em auditorias de pesquisa clínica;

Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo. A empresa apoia ativamente o desenvolvimento dos seus empregados e as oportunidades de crescimento são muito amplas.
  • Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios atrativo que inclui plano de saúde e odontológico, vale-refeição e alimentação, previdência privada, seguro de vida, wellhub, programa de incentivo de idioma e pós-graduação, além de opções de compra de ações da ENGIE.
  • Sabemos que o equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional é fundamental para seu bem-estar. Por isso, nosso regime de trabalho é hibrido e flexível ! Você pode trabalhar de casa até 1 dia por semana e pode iniciar suas atividades entre 7h30 e 9h30 e encerrar entre 16h30 e 18h30, respectivamente.
  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

A sua missão

Como Estagiário(a) do nosso departamento de Meio Ambiente, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias, desempenhando um papel crucial no desenvolvimento de estudos, programas e projetos socioeconômicos.

A sua principal responsabilidade será

  • Apoiar a área de engenharia de recursos hídricos e meio ambiente da Tractebel em atividades que envolvam estudos e projetos sustentáveis.

Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com

  • Cursando Engenharias.
  • Disciplina realizada de hidrologia/hidráulicas;
  • Facilidade para programação Python e com dados;
  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de geoprocessamento (ArcGIS/ QGis e AutoCAD);
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office.

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE , com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

Candidate-se agora mesmo!

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS;

description:

O que Buscamos:

- Forte conhecimento e interesse em gestão financeira, com capacidade analítica para interpretar relatórios e tomar decisões estratégicas.

- Experiência na otimização de processos e na implementação de novas ferramentas e metodologias.

- Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de clínicas e CRM; experiência com Clínica nas Nuvens será um grande diferencial.

title: Merchant Onboarding Analyst (Night Shift Position)
description:
About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more: Keeta website.

THIS POSITION REQUIRES AVAILABILITY TO WORK IN-PERSON FROM 15:15 PM TO 00:00 ON A 5X2 SCALE.

What you'll Do :

1. Review documents and information provided by merchants to ensure accuracy before the store goes live.

2. Upload and verify merchant account details, ensuring all information is complete, correct, and efficiently processed.

3. Check merchant qualifications according to company rules.

4. Review other applications submitted by business colleagues or merchants.

5. Organize and manage store photo-taking services.

6. Work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including night shifts and weekends.

7. Collaborate with Operations, Product, and other relevant teams to support merchant onboarding and resolve related issues.

What we need from You :

1. Responsible and reliable, willing to work hard to achieve team goals.

2. Eager to learn, open to new things, and able to adapt to changes.

3. Good communication skills, a team player, and willing to grow together with others.

4. Portuguese speaker, fluent in both spoken and written Portuguese. sales support is a plus (training will be provided).

5. Willing and able to work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including shift weekends. 6. Able to work efficiently under pressure, especially during peak periods, and handle handovers and transitions between teams smoothly.

7. Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail in managing shift tasks and onboarding processes.

What makes this role excinting :

1.Take part in the rapid growth of Meituan's global delivery business, work with an international team, and enjoy plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

2.Friendly and supportive team environment, where helps each other and grows together. Fun and relaxed atmosphere with everyone clear career development paths.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Gerente de Projetos

• Forte orientação a resultados, controle e governança.

title: CS / CX (Relacionamento ao cliente)
description:
VAGA: Assistente de Relacionamento com Cliente (CS/CX) – MYM Company

PRESENCIAL em São Caetano do Sul – Bairro Cerâmica

Remuneração (Regime PJ): R$ 2.000,00 - R$3.500,00 + Bonificação de acordo com o resultado.

Horário sugerido : Segunda a Sexta, das 10:00 às 19:00 horas

Vaga Efetiva (com experiência de 3 meses)

SOBRE A MYM COMPANY

A MYM Company é uma consultoria empresarial digital que nasceu pra transformar o mercado.

Não somos agência, não vendemos fórmulas prontas e não acreditamos em atalhos.

A gente atua lado a lado com os donos de negócio, colocando estratégia, gestão e execução pra gerar previsão, recorrência e escala .

Aqui não existe espaço pra trabalho meia boca.

Estamos construindo a maior consultoria empresarial digital da nação, queremos pessoas com fome de resultado, que enxergam cada cliente como o próximo case de sucesso .

SEU OBJETIVO

Seu papel é garantir que cada projeto seja executado com clareza, fluidez e excelência — do onboarding ao fechamento.

O jogo é claro: se o cliente renova, indica, e vira case… você venceu, e será recompensado por isso!

Você será responsável por garantir uma experiência consultiva memorável , acompanhando o cliente nos bastidores e garantindo que tudo seja cumprido com excelência.Vaga para Assistente de Relacionamento com Cliente (CS/CX)

ATIVIDADES :

• Conduzir o onboarding e o relacionamento ativo com os clientes da consultoria;

• Acompanhar a execução do projeto junto ao time, garantindo entregas claras e no prazo;

• Identificar dúvidas, desalinhamentos ou frustrações antes que virem problemas;

• Coletar feedbacks estratégicos e transformar em melhoria contínua;

• Captar depoimentos de impacto para usar como prova social e alavanca de captação;

• Garantir que o cliente esteja ciente de cada fase, responsável por suas partes, e pronto para renovar ao final do ciclo.

CONHECIMENTO NECESSÁRIO

• Gestão de relacionamento com clientes exigentes

• Organização impecável de prazos, status e entregas

• Comunicação escrita e verbal empática, mas firme

• Capacidade de mediação de conflito e resolução proativa

• Leitura de cenário, senso de dono e proatividade de verdade

• Familiaridade com marketing, vendas ou projetos digitais (mesmo que básica)

title: Especialista em Confiabilidade
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Foco: acessos venosos difíceis, apoio a procedimentos médicos e rotinas de terapias endovenosas com acolhimento premium.

Principais responsabilidades

Acesso venoso de alta complexidade: punção periférica em veias de difícil acesso, seleção de calibres, prevenção de extravasamento, manejo de intercorrências e registro completo.

Terapias endovenosas (soroterapia): preparo asséptico, conferência de prescrições, checagem dupla, montagem de equipo/bomba, definição e monitoramento de gotejamento, controle de sinais vitais e bem-estar do paciente.

Suporte a procedimentos médicos e estéticos:

  • Preparar sala, materiais, antissepsia e campos.

  • Orientar cuidados pós-procedimento e realizar follow-up ativo quando indicado.
  • Avaliações e monitoramento: aferição de sinais vitais; apoio em bioimpedância e calorimetria indireta (organização e preparo do paciente); triagem básica antes de procedimentos.

Gestão de segurança e qualidade:

  • Manter carrinho de emergência, checar validade/funcionalidade, cumprir POPs, CCIH/boas práticas.
  • Controle de estoque (insumos, materiais perfurocortantes, cadeia fria quando aplicável), rastreabilidade de lotes e notificação de eventos adversos.

Experiência do paciente: acolhimento carismático, linguagem clara, manejo de ansiedade/fobia de agulha, privacidade e LGPD (consentimentos e registros).

Documentação e comunicação: prontuário completo e legível, comunicação ágil via canais internos.

Requisitos
  • Formação e COREN ativos.
  • Experiência com terapias endovenosas.
  • Vivência em procedimentos ambulatoriais/estéticos.
  • Domínio de técnicas assépticas, biossegurança e gerenciamento de intercorrências.
  • Carisma, empatia e excelente comunicação.
Diferenciais desejáveis
  • BLS/ACLS atualizado.
  • Experiência com bombas de infusão e protocolos de soroterapia.
  • Vivência em clínicas de nutrologia, dermatologia ou estética avançada.
  • Organização exemplar e foco em experiência premium do paciente.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

No Brasil conta, anualmente, com cerca de 3 mil empregados diretos, em todas as suas instalações. A capacidade instalada de processamento de tabaco nas unidades fabris da companhia é de 220 mil toneladas/ano.

Com atuação em cerca de 350 municípios, através de suas equipes de campo, a empresa investe forte na relação com seus 16 mil produtores integrados, sempre focada nos princípios e práticas de sustentabilidade.

title: Desenvolvedor de Backend .NET
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Líder global em soluções transacionais , conecta empresas, empregados e comerciantes há mais de 50 anos. title: Mid/Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!

VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.

We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.

What you will do :

  • Design and implement backend services using Kotlin and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and QA teams to deliver high-quality features.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following best practices.
  • Contribute to system design and architecture discussions.

What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Solid experience with Kotlin and/or Spring Boot.
  • Understanding of REST API design and best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, queries, optimization).
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).

Senior-level:

  • Deep expertise with Kotlin and Spring Boot, including complex system design.
  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures.
  • Strong focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Ability to mentor junior/mid engineers and lead technical initiatives.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability practices.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.

If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities

Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes

Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures

Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Analista de Pré-Vendas (SDR)
description:
Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?

Somos a Doctoralia , empresa do grupo Docplanner , e estamos presentes em 13 países , sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês!

Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.

Nossa missão é "Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis"

Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos : marketplace , que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório, fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online . Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android .

Job Description

  • Prospectar ativamente potenciais clientes via telefone , e-mail, WhatsApp e redes sociais, utilizando estratégias de cold calling e cadências outbound.
  • Gerar interesse nos potenciais clientes, fazendo uma abordagem consultiva para entender suas necessidades e como nossas soluções podem ajudá-los.
  • Qualificar os leads , analisando criticamente se há fit com nossas soluções antes de direcioná-los ao Executivo de Vendas.
  • Manter um pipeline organizado no CRM (Salesforce) e em planilhas internas, garantindo o registro detalhado de cada contato.
  • Executar sequências de contato (automatizadas e personalizadas) de forma consistente para maximizar o engajamento com os prospects.
  • Fazer follow-up constante com os leads, respeitando a cadência definida para cada etapa do funil.
  • Acompanhar métricas e indicadores , propondo otimizações no processo de prospecção e buscando constantemente a melhoria dos resultados.

Qualifications

  • Experiência prévia com prospecção Outbound (SDR ou Pré-vendas), incluindo cold calling.
  • Conhecimento de CRM (Salesforce é um diferencial) e ferramentas de automação de vendas.
  • Foco em resultados , com ambição e motivação para bater metas agressivas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, essencial para criar rapport e transmitir valor rapidamente.
  • Organização e senso de urgência , importantes para gerenciar diversos leads simultaneamente e não perder oportunidades.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e persuasão , habilidades-chave para contornar objeções e manter ritmo constante de prospecção.
  • Interesse em construir carreira na área de vendas e prospecção de novos negócios, buscando crescimento e aprendizado constante.

Modelo de Trabalho

  • Híbrido para profissionais localizados no Rio de Janeiro.
  • Fornecemos o material necessário, mas, é fundamental ter um local adequado e acesso estável à internet.
  • Remoto para todo o Brasil

Additional information

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.

Key responsibilities:

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Analítico Pleno
description:
Venha fazer parte da Nação Azul!

Como será o seu dia a dia:

Desenvolver e validar métodos analíticos, com foco em métodos de dissolução/perfis de dissolução, realizar análises físico-químicas, análises para ajustes de formulação em aparato II/aparato IV, análises para bioisenção de formas farmacêuticas/diferentes dosagens de medicamentos, seguindo as Boas Práticas de Laboratório e em conformidade com as Legislações vigentes, através de técnicas analíticas como Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (CLAE/ UPLC), Cromatografia Gasosa (CG) e Headspace (CG- HS), Espectrômetro Ultravioleta e Visível (UV – VIS) para novos projetos e/ou adequação de portfólio;

Realizar pesquisa bibliográfica, através de busca em farmacopeias, revistas especializadas e artigos científicos;

Avaliar as monografias farmacopeias, verificando e documentando a sua adequabilidade;

Realizar e avaliar análises físico-químico em matérias-primas, produtos pilotos, produtos acabados, produtos em processo, água, preenchendo os registros de análise, laudos, solicitações de análise, registros de uso de equipamentos e logbooks;

Acompanhar a calibração e qualificação de equipamentos e sua manutenção, avaliando o certificado de calibração de equipamentos;

Fazer o levantamento das necessidades de compras de materiais para o desenvolvimento dos estudos analíticos, realizando e levantamento de informações técnicas do produto junto aos fornecedores;

Auxiliar analistas seniores e Pesquisadores no desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos para produtos terminados, matérias-primas, resíduos de limpeza, suporte de processos de controle da qualidade, validação de processos, validação de limpeza, estudos de estabilidade, desenvolvimento de produtos e outros, referenciando-se em normas locais regulatórias, corporativas, nacionais e internacionais para novos produtos e adequação de portfólio;

Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais padrão, manuais técnicos, especificações de requerimento de usuário, especificações técnicas, especificações e métodos analíticos e outros documentos;

Elaborar e revisar protocolos e relatórios de validação conferindo os dados sequenciais para que seja de fácil entendimento e execução;

Conduzir estudo de estabilidade e foto estabilidade e elaborar o protocolo dos estudos, elaborando planilhas, avaliando resultados e tendência, analisando amostras de estabilidade e qualificação.

Para fazer acontecer, você precisa:

Mandatórios:

Educação Superior completa em Farmácia ou Química;

Conhecimento em análise de dissolução/perfis de dissolução;

Conhecimento nas legislações vigentes (RDC 31, RDC 749, RDC 166, etc.)

Diferencial:

Atuação In Vivo e In Vitro;

Conhecimento em Correlação.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).

In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.

No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.

To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.

Like what you see? Apply now!

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager - LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.

PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE

MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:

  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Técnico de qualidade
description:
A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. Com mais de 11.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é projetar soluções seguras e inovadoras que aproximem pessoas, promovam inclusão social e facilitem o acesso ao emprego, à educação e ao lazer em todo o mundo.

Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. Estamos presentes em mais de 80 países, incluindo o Brasil, que conta com mais de 800 colaboradores.

No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias.

A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro.

Para maiores informações acesse

Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional.

A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.

A atuação da Patrimonial Segurança é pautada em três pilares fundamentais:

· Tecnologia Avançada: Utilizando equipamentos modernos, sistemas de monitoramento eletrônico, alarmes e controle de acesso, a empresa garante um alto nível de eficiência no combate a incidentes.

title: Analista de M&A
description:
About Us

For 12 years, CELA – Clean Energy Latin America has provided financial and strategic advisory to companies and investors in the renewable energy and energy transition sectors across Latin America.

We work in consulting (strategy, market, and regulatory), capital raising, project finance, and mergers & acquisitions, covering solar, wind, energy storage, and green hydrogen.

We are recognized for technical excellence, innovation, independence, and a commitment to positive, lasting, and measurable impact.

For more information, visit:

Position: M&A Analyst
Profile

We are seeking an analyst to join CELA’s financial advisory team focused on M&A and capital raising for energy transition and decarbonization projects.

This professional will play an active role in analyzing and structuring complex financial transactions, contributing to decisions that shape the future of the energy sector.

We are looking for someone with a strong analytical foundation, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to delivering high-quality, relevant work.

A proactive mindset is essential, along with a desire to develop across topics such as corporate finance, economics, and law, plus interest in financial modeling of companies in sectors including solar/wind power, batteries, biogas/biomethane, green hydrogen, e-mobility, among others.

We value professionals committed to the energy transition, capable of cultivating strategic relationships and contributing to the continued success of our financial advisory practice.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support all phases of M&A transactions (buy-side and sell-side) and capital raising via equity and debt.
  • Prepare presentations, teasers, CIMs, financial models, and company valuations (DCF, trading/transaction multiples, and precedent transactions).
  • Monitor regulatory and tax developments in CELA’s focus sectors.
  • Provide support to CELA’s research, strategy consulting, and investment analysis teams as needed.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, Economics, or quantitative fields.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint (required); Power BI (preferred).
  • Fluent English.
  • Ability to work remotely, with one monthly visit to the office (Vila Olimpia–SP) and client meetings as required by the project.
  • Full-time availability, with exclusivity.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in renewable energy and energy transition projects, or in the energy sector.
  • Experience in mergers and acquisitions, private equity, strategy consulting, financial modeling, investment analysis, financial analysis, or corporate finance.
  • CFA Level I/II or currently pursuing the certification.
  • Preparatory courses for capital markets/investment banking such as BTC – General Business Program, among others.
Compensation

Competitive and commensurate with experience.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their CV to Irving Petrazzini at

with the subject line “CV – M&A Analyst.”

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in building, optimizing, and managing data pipelines and modern cloud-based data platforms. This role involves designing scalable, secure, and high-performance data ecosystems for global clients while collaborating closely with data scientists, BI teams, and architects. The ideal candidate has experience in big data processing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cloud-native services, particularly on Azure OpenAI.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines for structured and unstructured data;
  • Develop and maintain data lakes, warehouses, and analytics platforms in the cloud;
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security compliance across environments;
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable data solutions;
  • Implement best practices for data storage, partitioning, and performance tuning;
  • Work with Azure cloud-native services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks) for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration;
  • Build real-time and batch data processing solutions using big data frameworks;
  • Partner with analysts and data scientists to support AI/ML and reporting initiatives;
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, workflows, and infrastructure issues;
  • Contribute to automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for data platforms.

Essential Skills

  • Experience in data engineering, architecture, or ETL development;
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing;
  • Advanced SQL expertise and proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server);
  • Hands-on experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Hadoop, Databricks);
  • Strong knowledge of Azure data services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks);
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Luigi, Prefect);
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB);
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, partitioning, and query optimization;
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal).

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming);
  • Familiarity with MLOps / AI pipelines to support data science workflows;
  • Knowledge of data governance and regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA);
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery models;
  • Prior work in a nearshore delivery environment supporting US/European clients;
  • Certifications in cloud platforms or data engineering (AWS Big Data Specialty, Azure Data Engineer Associate, GCP Data Engineer).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. title: Gerente Gestão de Pessoas (Industrial)
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

  • Objetivo do Cargo

Assegurar a estruturação e gestão estratégica da área de Pessoas da área industrial, alinhando políticas, práticas e cultura corporativa à matriz , de forma a garantir a atração, o desenvolvimento e a retenção de talentos necessários à implantação e futura operação da nova planta de celulose em Inocência - MS, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro, inclusivo e de alta performance.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Implantação da Área de Pessoas:

  • Habilidade em conduzir rituais de gestão (daily, reuniões de SLA, fóruns de performance);
  • Experiência em elaboração de apresentações executivas e comunicação de resultados;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão logística e metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma, PDCA);

title: Trade Lane Manager Americas
description:
Job Summary

Do you want to be part of transformation journey for SKF Group Supply Chain: securing most efficient set up for the inbound trade lanes into Americas geographical region, exploring all relevant transport modes (air, ocean, rail, road, express), proactively seeking alternative solutions to deliver customer value in close collaboration with the local shipping and receiving units? Do you enjoy working in the global environment with the stakeholders at different levels, challenging existing ways of working in a positive and constructive way? Are you eager to learn and be challenged? Do you enjoy leading across cultures without having formal authority? Then we are looking forward to hearing from you! As Trade Lane Manager Americas, you combine responsibilities for the region with the global ownership of suppliers and projects.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible at the specialist level for the efficient configuration of transportation for inbound commercial routes in a defined geographic region, exploring all relevant modes of transport (air, sea, rail, road, express).
  • Logistics supplier owner and contract owner for global defined transport suppliers, drive negotiations, contracting and rate reviews with appointed suppliers, proactively challenging existing ways of working as well as exploring new solutions
  • Responsible for following market trends, geopolitical developments, actively drive and support global/regional tenders, proactively working with local units for optimized solutions as well as responsible for contingency plan management and communication for appointed trade lanes
  • Supplier relationship management including business reviews, improvement plans, deployment of solutions in the defined geographical region.
  • Drive and support initiatives to reduce transport emission footprint in the defined geographical area,
  • Responsible for master data for relevant lanes, lead time, rate and spend development, volume development, SCAC codes etc.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Good knowledge of transport/logistics management as well as related procurement
  • Strong negotiation and contractual skills, ability to use TCO (total cost of ownership) approach in making decisions
  • Strong leadership skills, ability to lead without having formal authority
  • Strong communication skills, ability to understand different cultures and manage stakeholders at different levels in the organization (both internal and external)
  • Proactive, able to take initiative and drive activities/projects to completion, with ability to lead global and / or regional tenders
  • Ability to drive change and manage change resistance in a constructive and positive way
  • Strong analytical skills, ability to work with large amounts of data and complex topics in a structured way. Power BI or equivalent skills are an advantage
  • Language skills: fluent English and Spanish, Portuguese is an advantage
  • University degree or equivalent within relevant practice

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

Role Overview

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects within scope, time, and budget constraints. This role focuses on managing cross-functional teams, ensuring stakeholder alignment, and driving operational excellence across diverse business initiatives. Unlike senior Program Managers, this position emphasizes hands-on project execution rather than portfolio-level strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Planning & Execution
  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor progress and adjust schedules as needed to meet deadlines.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational project management methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project updates.
  • Prepare and present status reports to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Risk & Issue Management
  • Identify potential risks early and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Escalate critical issues promptly to leadership.
  • Budget & Resource Management
  • Track project budgets and ensure cost-effective delivery.
  • Coordinate with resource managers for staffing needs.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Maintain compliance with internal standards and client expectations.
  • Conduct post-project reviews and implement lessons learned.

✅ Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, or related field.
  • PMP certification preferred (or equivalent like PRINCE2).
  • Project management experience in IT or business domains.
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile).
  • Proficiency in tools like MS Project, JIRA, Confluence.

title: Analista de Execução
description:
Sobre a vaga

A COFCO International é uma empresa global de agronegócios que compra, armazena, vende, processa e distribui commodities agrícolas essenciais: grãos, oleaginosas, açúcar, algodão e café. Com sede em Genebra, na Suíça, a COFCO International emprega cerca de 11 mil profissionais, em 37 países, e possui ativos em todos os continentes, com negociações em mais de 50 países. A COFCO International é uma plataforma de agronegócios da COFCO Corporation, uma das maiores companhias agrícolas e de alimentos da China, com atuação global.

Responsabilidades

  • Responsável pela consolidação das descargas pertinentes aos contratos FCA, análise de contratos, elaboração da memória de cálculo para pré-pagamento e/ou embarque dos navios de acordo com as premissas contratuais de cada contraparte;
  • Realizar o follow-up diário das descargas do Sugar Trading em todos os terminais os quais estivermos operando;
  • Controle do estoque de açúcar recebido nos terminais, mantendo a Execução e Contábil atualizados e, agindo como interface entre Execução, Comercial, Logística e Controladoria.
  • Analisar as premissas contratuais de cada contraparte a fim de elaborar as memórias de cálculo para pré-pagamento semanal (quando aplicável) e a memória de cálculo final após a conclusão do embarque;
  • Manter a tesouraria atualizados das previsões de pagamento do Sugar Trading, visando obter as operações na data e da forma correta, e mantendo as demais áreas atualizadas sobre o fluxo de caixa da operação (pré-pagamento e pagamentos do produto).

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Administração, Comércio Exterior e áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote Office - Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento em SAP e Datasul;
  • Experiência na área no ramo do agronegócio;
  • Habilidades númericas/ analíticas.

A COFCO International é uma empresa que promove a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os talentos qualificados são bem-vindos e considerados para nossas vagas, sem distinção de raça ou etnia, crença religiosa, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, idade, pessoa com deficiência (PcD) e outras características protegidas por lei.

Para saber como a COFCO International coleta e processa os seus dados pessoais durante a sua candidatura de emprego, por favor consulte a nossa Política de Privacidade.

  • Sólida experiência na área Comercial como vendedor pleno;

Local de Atuação: Ceará e Piauí

About the Company

LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.

Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.

Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products either under leading global non-latex condom brands SKYN® under its local heroes such as LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control®.

Outside of branded products, the Company also supports universities, NGOs, and other organizations as part of a broader effort to promote sexual health and prevent the spread of STDs and STIs. LifeStyles owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Thailand, India and Spain, and it employs over 1,600 teammates globally.

LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017 , when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell.

As of December 1, 2022, Lifestyles is owned by Linden Capital Partners , a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on the healthcare industry.

This is an exciting time to join us. We combine century-long history with the opportunity of a new beginning as a stand-alone company - this means a new way of thinking, the opportunity to explore new horizons and the chance to make a mark in an exciting, fresh business.

LifeStyles Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are empowered professionals, and we are committed to creating a team of the world’s “best of the best.” Our business foundation is strong, among our values are Integrity and Respect, our people are highly engaged, and we are excited about a new phase in the company history. We have a focus on safety and teamwork - and we want you to join us!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
